note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension row added by the site. The template has no such line; it is shown only when the amount is not nil, marked as absent from the template.

definition.zh-TW: 償還長期借款本金時付出的現金。
definition.en: Cash paid to repay the principal of long-term borrowings.
